evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Scope and behavior are concrete and small enough to estimate (UI form, create resource).

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: Functionality is clear and bounded (generate/share URL, access control).

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Specific UI action and outcome; implementable and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Clear display requirement (list of items for session); estimable.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Behavior is concrete (select and signal item); can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: A bounded feature (add item) with clear scope; estimable.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific CRUD operation; scope is small and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded action (delete); reasonable to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Behavior is specific (reveal estimates even if some missing); implementable and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined action (compute/accept average); scope is clear for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Concrete trigger and outcome; small and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simple, bounded UI interaction; estimable without detailed design.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Behavior is concrete (re-select previously estimated item and allow re-estimate); estimable.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: A clear integration task (parse spreadsheet/import rows); scope is sufficiently specified to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Specific input behavior (paste to import); bounded and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing/listing previous games is a concrete UI feature; can be estimated (may detail pagination/filtering later).

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Specific output requirement (transcript view); scope is clear enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Well-defined export format and action; estimable.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Clear, bounded requirement (CSV export); can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Delete operation with expected outcome; estimable (may require cascade behavior but still scoping is clear).

evaluations.rationale: Concrete signup fields and result; straightforward to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Standard, bounded feature (authentication); estimable without more detail.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Generic edit account capability is a bounded task; specifics can be clarified but estimation is possible.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Delete account behavior is specific enough to estimate (including data removal policy to be refined later).

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Clear technical requirement (timezone conversion/display); estimable.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Standard, bounded feature (password reset/reminder via email); can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Concrete configuration option with clear choices; scope is bounded and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Clear limit on team size; implementable and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Specific join flow; small and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Simple display requirement; estimable.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Display/listing requirement with clear scope; can be estimated.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Concrete indicator behavior; implementation effort is bounded and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear synchronization behavior and trigger; can be reasonably estimated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Well-scoped interaction rule; estimable.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Specific data-display requirement (history per estimator for current story); scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Concrete requirement (mapping estimators to their estimates); implementable and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Specific functionality (two-minute shared timer); bounded and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Clear trigger and behavior (auto-reset); estimable.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: History browsing is a concrete feature; scope is clear enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Deterministic UI ordering requirement; implementable and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Clear interaction constraint; bounded and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Concrete UI element with defined placement; effort is estimable.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is measurable and sufficiently specific to form an implementation estimate (test/fix efforts).

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Small, bounded deliverable (glossary) and estimable.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Developer task with concrete actions (identify and create indexes); estimable.

evaluations.evidence: have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific browser/version list defines scope; although potentially effortful, it's concrete enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: "Where possible" and no scope of which guidelines or exceptions makes effort and scope underspecified, preventing a reliable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: No metric for "quickly" or target performance thresholds given, making reasonable implementation estimates impossible.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Technical requirement (Unicode support) is concrete and bounded; estimable.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Though somewhat subjective, this is an implementable URL design requirement and small enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Subjective term "nice" but feature is a bounded UI deliverable and can be estimated (design + implementation).

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: "Non-identifiable" is underspecified (what identifiers, anonymization technique, legal/privacy requirements), preventing a reliable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: "Some metrics" is vague (which metrics, aggregation, time ranges), making scope and effort unclear for estimation.
